body.message: Power/Fan: Press the low, medium, or high speed button on the control panel, or gently pull the sliding front visor/lever forward.Lights: Press the dedicated light button (often marked with a bulb icon) on the control panel to turn on the cooking area lights.Speed Adjustment: Press higher or lower speed buttons to match your cooking intensity.
